CONSULTANT

International Not-for-Profit Organization
Delhi Short-Term Consultancy Contracts Mid 5-6 Years Apply by October 20, 2026

Job Description

1. POSITIONS VACANT: Consultant, International Not-for-Profit Organization, Remote.

 

2. ORGANISATIONAL BACKGROUND:

 

Our client is a respected international not-for-profit, that works in public health, to improve the health of disadvantaged communities, across the globe.



3. JOB DESCRIPTION/ RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

The Consultant will be responsible is to develop the web portal and backend services of the application. The consultant will build the web portal for the State, National, institute principals and administrator, develop the backend services and the APIs to be used by the mobile app. The consultant will work closely with the Client program and mobile app teams. S/he will be responsible for the following work;

 

Key Job Responsibilities: 

 

(1) Web Portal Development - Design, develop, and deploy a comprehensive web portal for State, National, and Institute Principals and Administrators, incorporating institute registration and pairing, user enrolment, visit planning, work plan management, messaging, notifications, meeting and training management, and role based access control to ensure secure and efficient use of the platform;


(2) Backend Services and API Development - Design, develop, and implement a microservices-based backend architecture with secure REST APIs to support the web portal and mobile application. The backend shall cover user authentication and access management, assessment tools and scoring mechanisms, visit management, work plans, notifications, and file management. Ensure seamless integration with the mobile application, troubleshoot technical issues, and resolve identified defects to maintain reliable system performance;


(3) Dashboards and Reporting- Design, develop, and implement interactive dashboards and reporting modules covering visits, project progress, meetings, training activities, and feedback. Incorporate appropriate filters and data visualization features, with options to export and download reports in PDF and Excel formats;

 

(4) Changes, Enhancements, and Refinements- Incorporate the changes, enhancements, and refinements communicated by Client throughout the consultancy engagement across the web portal, backend services, dashboards, reporting modules, and associated functionalities, including modifications and updates to the assessment tool, as required and mutually agreed upon;


(5) Server Hosting and Maintenance- Provide, configure, host, and maintain the server infrastructure required to operate the web portal and backend services for a period of 12 months from the date of go-live. Ensure appropriate data setup, regular backups, system monitoring, and operational maintenance to support the availability, security, and performance of the platform. All data, user accounts, and associated information shall remain the exclusive property of Client;

(6) Technical Documentation and Handover- Prepare and submit comprehensive technical documentation, including API specifications, system architecture details, deployment procedures, and relevant configuration and maintenance guidelines. Hand over the complet source code and technical assets to Client;

4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:

 

Qualifications and Experience:

(1) Applicants must have Bachelor / master’s degree with relevant experience;
(2) Minimum 5 years of experience in web application development, of which at least 3 years in backend development with Java and Spring Boot;
(3) Must have developed and deployed at least two web portals with backend services, including APIs used by mobile applications;

(4) Experience in hosting and maintaining applications on cloud servers;

(5) Experience in health information technology projects for national, state or district government programs;

 

Skills and Competencies:

(1) Java, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud (API gateway, service registry) for microservices;

(2) REST API design and documentation;

(3) Security: JWT sign-in, role-based access control and secure handling of data;
(4) PostgreSQL/SQL database design and optimization;

(6) React with TypeScript for responsive web portals; Angular is an advantage;

(7) Dashboards and reports with PDF and Excel export;

(8) Cloud deployment (AWS, Azure or similar), Docker, backups and monitoring;

(9) Proficient in Git and code versioning;

(10) Excellent written and verbal communication skills;

 

5. CONSULTANCY FEE: Gross compensation budgeted for the position is attractive. Please note that the offer made to the selected candidate shall be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and salary history.

 

6. LOCATION: Remote

7. REFERENCE: C-R-D-INPO

 

8. NATURE OF CONTRACT:

 

The selected candidate shall be engaged as a Consultant on the rolls of SAMS, a third-party payrolling agency, for a full-time consultancy engagement initially offered for a period of Three months. The contract is extendable based on performance and project requirements. It is explicitly clarified that this consultancy engagement does not constitute a promise or guarantee of future employment, with SAMS, or our client, or any other organization associated with the project.



9. CONTACT INFORMATION:

Strategic Alliance Management Services P Ltd.
1/1B, Choudhary Hetram House, Bharat Nagar 
New Friends Colony, New Delhi 110 025

Phone Nos.: 011- 4081 9900; 4165 3612

Eligible candidates interested in the position are requested to urgently apply before October 20, 2026.

   About the job MRJ have partnered with one of the UK's leading technology driven organisations as they continue to invest heavily in AI, Automation and enterprise-wide digital transformation. This is an opportunity to shape the future architecture of the business is they look to embrace AI, automation and cloud technologies at scale. Working as part of a newly established AI Centre of Excellence, you'll design enterprise solutions that have genuine business impact across multiple functions. If you're passionate about AI, enterprise architecture and solving complex business challenges through technology, this is a fantastic opportunity to influence strategy while remaining close to delivery. The Role: We're looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to lead the design of AI-powered and Intelligent Automation solutions across a large-scale enterprise. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Technical Architects and Engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions aligned with long-term strategic objectives. This is a highly influential role where you'll help define architectural standards, shape technology roadmaps and ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable and commercially effective. Day-to-day Responsibilities: Design end-to-end enterprise solutions across AI, Generative AI and Intelligent Automation. Define solution architectures that align with business strategy, architecture principles and technology standards. Partner with Product Owners, Engineering teams and senior stakeholders to translate business challenges into technology solutions. Design integration strategies across APIs, microservices, enterprise platforms and cloud environments. Guide engineering teams through delivery, ensuring solutions remain aligned with architectural standards. Define AI architecture principles, governance and best practice across the organisation. Produce high-level and detailed solution designs, technical documentation and architecture artefacts. Identify technical risks, security considerations and scalability challenges throughout delivery. Contribute to technology roadmaps and evaluate emerging technologies to support future innovation. Coach and mentor Solution Architects while helping develop the wider Architecture function. What They're Looking For: Proven experience as a Solution Architect, Software Architect or Enterprise Architect. Strong experience designing enterprise AI, Automation or Generative AI solutions. Excellent understanding of cloud platforms including Azure , AWS or Google Cloud . Experience designing large-scale distributed architectures using APIs, Microservices and modern integration patterns. Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, MLOps, DevOps and AI delivery practices. Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF. Experience producing architecture documentation, standards and governance. Strong stakeholder management with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Passion for innovation with the ability to balance technical excellence against commercial delivery. Next Steps If you're passionate about Enterprise Architecture, AI and Intelligent Automation, and want to play a key role in delivering large-scale transformation programmes, we'd love to hear from you.
